title: WordPress Plugin & Theme Developer Leads Input
description: Query the WordPress.org directory and extract developer leads. Pay per lead.

keywords.title: Search keywords
keywords.description: Terms to search the directory for (e.g. seo, backup, woocommerce). Each is one query, paginated.

browse.title: Browse mode (instead of keywords)
browse.description: Pull a directory list instead of a keyword search. Leave blank to use keywords.

maxLeads.title: Max leads
maxLeads.description: Cap total leads per run, ranked by active installs. Kept small by default so a first run is cheap; raise it for a full pull.

maxPerKeyword.title: Max per keyword
maxPerKeyword.description: Cap results taken from each keyword (paginated, 100 per page).

minInstalls.title: Minimum active installs
minInstalls.description: Drop plugins below this install count. Zero keeps everything (themes have no install count).

qualifiedMinInstalls.title: Qualified install bar
qualifiedMinInstalls.description: Installs at or above this, with a scraped email, tier a lead as qualified_lead.

includeEmail.title: Scrape contact emails
includeEmail.description: Fetch each top lead's company website and scrape a contact email.

maxEmailLookups.title: Max email lookups
maxEmailLookups.description: Cap how many top leads get the website email scrape, to bound run time.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The WordPress.org API needs no proxy; provided for parity.
